parts.name: Switch
parts.Basic_description: This is the lever or toggle part of the switch, typically made of stainless steel for durability and tactile feedback.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to manually open or close the electrical circuit by flipping the lever up or down.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates or pivots around a fixed axis to change the electrical state of the switch.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main housing of the switch, usually made of insulating plastic to protect internal electrical contacts.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the internal components, provides insulation, and supports the external terminals for wiring connections.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the structural support for the moving switch lever.
